body:
To start out with I bought a ounce of medium grade shrooms and tried low doses (12-17g) with little effect. I then decided to pay
A Bad Recipe and Weird Experience
2x as much to get the A grade and B grade to mix. I thought I had a great idea for a soup recipe, after my first experience where I threw the caps in with chicken noodle. The first soup was ok, I just didnt like the sand inside the caps.
So for my third trip I put 30 grams in the blender with some cream of chicken soup and a lemon. When I stopped blending I realized my mistake. It smelled like shit. It looked like shit. Then pouring into a large glass and taking a gulp I realized it tasted like shit. I got the first third down ok, then over a course of 45 min. I kept going back and taking smaller and smaller gulps just not to barf. I eventually got a powerade, filled half my mouth with that and then take a gulp of the shit shake. I drank almost all of it (weeks later this is still giving me nausea thinking about it
weeks later this is still giving me nausea thinking about it
) and started playing guitar hero.
After another hour had passed I couldnt focus enough on it so I started to watch tv. After this is near blackout. I remember feeking a buzzing in my feet and it and my vision would flash quickley through my body and up through my head. I have no recollection of what show I was watching or the phone ringing. I later heard the answering machine beeping and listening to the message, my sibling wanted me to bring it a swimming suit. I thought ohhhhh fuck and went to bed. The last thing I remember was my sibling talking to me. Later I was told that I was making little sense.
This whole experience sucked because I really underestimated the dosage of A grade shrooms. I am going to try this same mix again but only at 15 grams.
